title: Vanilla Valley SMP
description: A vanilla plus Minecraft server focused on exploration and community
body: # 🍦Vanilla Valley SMP This server is focused on catering to everyone, giving them the best experience possible. Whether you like exploring, taking it slow, building, or pvp, this is the server for you. ## 🖨️Features - Fully custom in-house mods - Mod suggestions (If you want a mod added, make a mod suggestion in the [discord](https://discord.gg/23KfgguXMC)!) - Custom structures - No microtransactions - Active playerbase ## 💬Discord Join the [discord](https://discord.gg/23KfgguXMC) for announcements, community, and the ability to suggest mods!
